visual_mismatch_ledger.observation: The leaning front plane and foot spacing are closer to the official front silhouette, but it remains an unsmoothed primary cage.
The middle depth section rises above the two outer top sections, producing a pointed roof. The official side reference has a short rounded crest and continuous A-frame legs instead.
The front plane now leans correctly, but the pointed center ridge invalidates the shell's most important folded profile.

technical_observations.base_topology: connected all-quad shell with integrated opening

retained_learning: Section-grid heights must be constrained across adjacent depth sections; an unmeasured center maximum creates a false pointed roof.
The official side view is decisive for the rollover: correct front silhouette cannot compensate for a wrong cross-section.
SubD, crease, bevel, display, and material remain deferred.
required_next_action: Rebuild using a bounded top-height band across the three sections, then repeat front/side/isometric evaluation before surface work.
